authority: semantic proposal scores only; no bank-write authorization

packet.provenance: Single designer authored synthetic engineering labels under current user authorization. No independent gold/IID claim. Authored heldout known to author, unevaluated, not blind safety qualification. No competition cases/actors/expectations, Tau reference task, customer logs or finalbrief constants used.
packet.grouping: Explicit scenario ancestry/paraphrases and contrasts stay together. C04->T04, C05/H05->T05 unioned and assigned TRAIN before fitting. Current-text and complete-input exact aliases checked across splits. Further independent semantic union review may reduce groups; do not inflate by rows.
packet.sanity: Six exposed retained cases use invented160/290 and14/22 May for two generic balances; not training, calibration, qualification or finalbrief facts.

labels.masks: known_mask=false has exactly zero supervised and distilled gradient; never substitute0 for unknown. One ambiguous bare Okay has current_affirm unknown and uncertain known-positive.
labels.scope: current_affirm includes administrative/recipient/component assent, not financial consent. current_withdraw distinguishes retracting prior grant/own plan from a first refusal. Reported third-party and hypothetical language do not create own promise. Proposal may be incomplete; normalization/completion/value/target and authority are separately UNKNOWN.

feature_contract.input: input.previous_utterances (chronological USER/SYSTEM role+text) plus current USER text only. Gold phase is never an input; phase is inferable only from observed utterances.
feature_contract.serialization: Join each observed turn as role + colon + text + newline, append current USER text last; same serializer for encoder/student. Keep at most last2 previous turns and current; this packet already satisfies that. Hash serializer/version with fit plan. No source scenario marker or label-derived redaction.
feature_contract.truncation: Token budget256 for MiniLM; verify all packet inputs fit before fitting. If not, freeze a deterministic observed-text truncation shared by both models; mask labels relying on removed evidence via TRAIN review, not heldout tuning. No secret DOB/account keys in features.
feature_contract.source_binding: Proposal includes caller-supplied current-turn and evidence-turn refs plus current input digest. Those references bind bytes for auditing; they do not cryptographically authenticate user speech. Unknown or stale ingress remains proposal/shadow.

runtime_output.label_scores: seven finite sigmoid probabilities, not normalized mutually-exclusive classes
runtime_output.label_mask: trained/knownness metadata per head, plus calibration_available distinct from raw score
runtime_output.scope_resolution: deterministic context/evidence target binding; model score alone cannot select product, normalize terms, authenticate recipient, prove consent, or confirm receipt

teacher.head: Fresh normalized384-vector ->7 independent linear logits. Train this head; do not reuse Banking77 classifier weights or map its77 labels to permission. No pickle; local-files-only safetensors encoder.
teacher.reference: Prior89.83% is Banking77 topic accuracy, not repayment/consent accuracy. New seven-head results are unknown.

student.input: Same observed serialized text as teacher. Signed deterministic SHA256 hashed unigram/bigram/character-trigram vector width1024, L2 normalized; role tokens retained.
student.comparison: One hard-label student and one distilled student receive identical fresh initial weights, features, masks, group weights, optimizer schedule and processed epochs. Encoder head is separate fresh fit. No graph-advantage claim from this MLP.
student.export: float32 base64 plus stdlib struct/math/base64 inference;33031 params=132124 raw bytes,176168 base64 bytes before metadata; measure each runtime+model<=500000 bytes. Full MiniLM91MB remains builder/offline reference, not portable student.

objective.group_weights: a_i=1/(G*n_i_group), using canonical group_id. For each head j, P=sum a_i*m_ij*y_ij; N=sum a_i*m_ij*(1-y_ij). q_j=min(5,max(1,sqrt(N/P))) from TRAIN only. If P or N=0, declare unsupported direction/untrained rather than fabricating evidence. No arbitrary20-group floor blocks auxiliary fit.
objective.masked_BCE: L_j=sum a_i*m_ij*[q_j*y_ij*softplus(-z_ij)+(1-y_ij)*softplus(z_ij)] / sum a_i*m_ij*[q_j*y_ij+(1-y_ij)]. Mean L_j over trainable heads; add .5*0.01*mean(nonbias_parameter^2). Group weights prevent four sibling paraphrases counting as four roots.
objective.distillation: Cache raw TRAIN logits from the newly fitted repayment teacher only. Student hard arm uses masked BCE. Distilled arm uses0.5*masked_BCE +0.5*T^2*group-and-known-mask-normalized Bernoulli_KL(sigmoid(teacher_raw/T)||sigmoid(student_raw/T)), T=2, identical regularizer. Never generate CAL/heldout teacher targets for training.
objective.weighted_probabilities: Class weighting alters sigmoid prevalence; report raw scores and separately calibrated decisions. Low TRAIN BCE or teacher agreement is not semantic generalization.

CPU_budget.timeout: Check total monotonic wall at batches. Preserve honest incomplete state; do not score unfinished pair or launch GPU/retry automatically. This is a cap, not predicted time.
CPU_budget.jobs: Designer does not fit. Parent relays pinned data and plan to Hooke. New source/model artifacts must be disjoint from frozen earlier experiments.

freeze_and_evaluation.before_fit: Pin every packet file including generator, canonical ancestry/alias unions/spec, encoder weight hash and new implementation/feature code. Write immutable fit plan and exact command/seeds/versions. Reject input drift; current user authorization covers actual auxiliary training, not bank authority.
freeze_and_evaluation.cal_method: Fit a fixed-grid temperature[.5,1,2,4] using CAL-fit only, if label has both known directions; otherwise T=1 with unsupported-calibration annotation. Threshold grid[.5,.6,.7,.8,.9] on CAL-select only; no accepted precision guarantee. A head lacking positive or negative selection support has selective acceptance unavailable; retain raw0.5 diagnostics. Do not fabricate coverage to make every head look finished.
freeze_and_evaluation.before_heldout: Freeze teacher/student weights, serializer, thresholds, masks and evaluation code. Heldout is read exactly once by evaluator for raw per-head precision/recall/F1/BCE, multi-label exact match, mask denominators, per-canonical-group errors and teacher/hard/distilled paired disagreements. No best checkpoint or settings selected on it.
freeze_and_evaluation.uncertainty: Only6 heldout authored groups, at most1-2 positive groups per head. Even zero error over all6 accepted independent groups would have one-sided95% zero-error upper risk1-.05^(1/6)=39.3%, and these roots are not proven independent; no safety/generalization claim. Future independent annotation/data collection and blind lineage-separated risk/OOD test required.
freeze_and_evaluation.ablation: Train-only context-removal feature control is a later frozen plan if needed, not an excuse to retune against heldout. Immediate matched hard/distilled student gives equal information and isolates teacher-target benefit.

checks: Cross-split canonical groups and aliases must be disjoint
Unknown element contributes exactly zero data/distillation gradient
Finite-difference one positive/negative/head; finite gradients and sigmoid scores
Model/evidence refs cannot authorize writes; admin or name affirmation is not readback consent
New amount/date correction cannot confirm old readback; scope siblings independently
Teacher/student native-export parity on TRAIN diagnostic rows only before heldout
All packet/model/code pins frozen; CAL and heldout never enter optimizer

optional_SGD_bridge.scope: If later augmenting with actual SGD TRAIN, use a separate publisher-act head AFFIRM/NEGATE/INFORM/REQUEST only from original actions where publisher-action mask true and observed context retained. All seven financial semantics masks remain false/UNKNOWN for those rows. Generic AFFIRM does not imply a payment promise/consent; NEGATE does not imply financial withdrawal. Source-frame services are not runtime routing features.
optional_SGD_bridge.split: Keep whole existing conversation/template ancestry roots in original TRAIN split; do not read official dev/test or reference-only Tau tasks.

builder_integration.authorized: User authorized MiniLM builder integration and real small semantic training. This contract does not launch either.
builder_integration.use: Builder can use local MiniLM/semantic proposal candidates to author or inspect generic graph; deterministic compiler/policygraph owns identity/security ordering, facts, scoped eligibility, current readback revisions, withdrawal and tool receipts.
builder_integration.platform: Fixed AGENT_LLM and bank-tool-only runtime remains binding. No unauthorized external inference API or new bank tool. Portable student integration needs source-compatible observed ingress; metadata bytes are not authentication.
builder_integration.bank_ground_truth: Dataset has no bank authority, actual consent/transaction success or ledger labels. Retain exact original competition kit/scorer/expectations and generic-source automatic builder route.
